fields.claim: The larger-dimple sweep, the perfect-sphere cases and the 1.10 calibration run on a coarser native family than the stated 512/2/6 boundary mesh: the perfect cases record 256/1/4, and the sweep's native RSS matches. CARD.md and METHOD.md describe only the boundary mesh. On a 4 mm own mesh the 11.8 mm face-yield estimate is 63.60 kPa, not 61.91, though inside the native bracket. Endpoints agree within 0.02 kPa, and the acceptance numbers are unaffected.
fields.needed_to_ground: State the mesh for every table; recompute the larger-dimple face-yield estimates on the boundary mesh.

qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma. [047 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:7472c3f9ee41a250), [056 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:a6b49a9c06df2016).
